text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see a Fool.
source_text: You see a Fool.

text: 你看见一个愚人。
source_text: 你看见一个愚人。

text: You see a ganger.
source_text: You see a ganger.

text: 你看见一个歹徒。
source_text: 你看见一个歹徒。

text: They call us Fools, but you's just stupid for showing up here.
source_text: They call us Fools, but you's just stupid for showing up here.

text: 他们叫我们愚人，但你在这儿露面也是很蠢的。
source_text: 他们叫我们愚人，但你在这儿露面也是很蠢的。

text: You gonna start something with us?
source_text: You gonna start something with us?

text: 你要和我们做点事吗？
source_text: 你要和我们做点事吗？

text: This ain't your place.
source_text: This ain't your place.

text: 这儿不是你的地盘。
source_text: 这儿不是你的地盘。

text: Don't think you can come walking in here and start something.
source_text: Don't think you can come walking in here and start something.

text: 别认为你能进来并做点什么事。
source_text: 别认为你能进来并做点什么事。

text: Watch out, or you can end up in a crypt, Crypt.
source_text: Watch out, or you can end up in a crypt, Crypt.

text: 小心，否则你会在一个土窟里终结生命，土窟人。
source_text: 小心，否则你会在一个土窟里终结生命，土窟人。

text: Yeah, we gonna work those Crypts.
source_text: Yeah, we gonna work those Crypts.

text: 是的，我们会奴役那些土窟人。
source_text: 是的，我们会奴役那些土窟人。

text: Scrapheap ain't gonna be the same without those Crypts. It's gonna be ours!
source_text: Scrapheap ain't gonna be the same without those Crypts. It's gonna be ours!

text: 没有那些土窟人废渣堆不会变得一样。它是我们的。
source_text: 没有那些土窟人废渣堆不会变得一样。它是我们的。

text: Ha ha ha! Ha ha ha ha!
source_text: Ha ha ha! Ha ha ha ha!

text: 嘿嘿嘿！哈哈哈哈！
source_text: 嘿嘿嘿！哈哈哈哈！

text: Fools! Fools! Fools! Yeah!
source_text: Fools! Fools! Fools! Yeah!

text: 愚人！愚人！愚人！是呀！
source_text: 愚人！愚人！愚人！是呀！

text: Didja hear the one about the chicken and the foxhole?
source_text: Didja hear the one about the chicken and the foxhole?

text: 你听过说小鸡和狐狸洞的事吗？
source_text: 你听过说小鸡和狐狸洞的事吗？

text: Be cool.
source_text: Be cool.

text: 很酷。
source_text: 很酷。

text: He who laughs last, laughs last.
source_text: He who laughs last, laughs last.

text: 最后笑的人才能笑到最后。
source_text: 最后笑的人才能笑到最后。

text: Life's a joke, yuk it up.
source_text: Life's a joke, yuk it up.

text: 生活就是个玩笑，就一笑而过吧。
source_text: 生活就是个玩笑，就一笑而过吧。

text: If it wasn't for them Crypts, we would rule this town. Or at least kick Lenny in the crotch.
source_text: If it wasn't for them Crypts, we would rule this town. Or at least kick Lenny in the crotch.

text: 如果不是因为他们土窟人，我们就能统治这个城镇。或者至少可以踢蓝尼的屁股。
source_text: 如果不是因为他们土窟人，我们就能统治这个城镇。或者至少可以踢蓝尼的屁股。

text: Be a fool.
source_text: Be a fool.

text: 扮的蠢点。
source_text: 扮的蠢点。

text: You think that puny leather will save you from Baka?
source_text: You think that puny leather will save you from Baka?

text: 你以为穿上那可怜的皮革就能把你从蠢蛋中解救出来？
source_text: 你以为穿上那可怜的皮革就能把你从蠢蛋中解救出来？

text: What happened? Your mom drop you on your head at birth?
source_text: What happened? Your mom drop you on your head at birth?

text: 怎么了？你妈生你的时候把你的头撞坏了吗？
source_text: 怎么了？你妈生你的时候把你的头撞坏了吗？

text: If I were that ugly, I'd kill myself.
source_text: If I were that ugly, I'd kill myself.

text: 如果我长得那么丑的话，我就自杀算了。
source_text: 如果我长得那么丑的话，我就自杀算了。

text: You Crypts look like you just came out of one.
source_text: You Crypts look like you just came out of one.

text: 你们土窟人看起来似乎都成一样的。
source_text: 你们土窟人看起来似乎都成一样的。

text: Only a fool would try something that stupid. Oh, wait, I am a Fool.
source_text: Only a fool would try something that stupid. Oh, wait, I am a Fool.

text: 只有笨蛋才会做这么蠢的事，噢，等等，我就是个笨蛋。
